035/**
036 * Session for serializing objects to Hjson format.
037 */
038@SuppressWarnings({
039   "resource", "java:S110", "java:S115", "java:S3776", "java:S6541",
040   "rawtypes", "unchecked"
041})
042public class HjsonSerializerSession extends WriterSerializerSession implements RecordWritable {
043
044   private static final String ARG_ctx = "ctx";
045
046   /**
047    * Builder for Hjson serializer session.
048    */
049   public static class Builder extends WriterSerializerSession.Builder<Builder> {
050
051      private HjsonSerializer ctx;
052
053      protected Builder(HjsonSerializer ctx) {
054         super(assertArgNotNull(ARG_ctx, ctx));
055         this.ctx = ctx;
056      }
057
058      @Override
059      public HjsonSerializerSession build() {
060         return new HjsonSerializerSession(this);
061      }
062   }
063
064   /**
065    * Creates a session builder.
066    *
067    * @param ctx The serializer context.
068    *    <br>Cannot be <jk>null</jk>.
069    * @return The builder.
070    */
071   public static Builder create(HjsonSerializer ctx) {
072      return new Builder(assertArgNotNull(ARG_ctx, ctx));
073   }
074
075   private final HjsonSerializer ctx;
076
077   protected HjsonSerializerSession(Builder builder) {
078      super(builder);
079      ctx = builder.ctx;
080   }
081
082   @Override /* RecordWritable */
083   public RecordWriter writeRecords(Object output) throws IOException {
084      return RecordAdapter.writer(this, output);
085   }
086
087   @Override /* RecordWritable */
088   public boolean isRecordStreaming() {
089      return false;
090   }
091
092   protected final HjsonWriter getHjsonWriter(SerializerPipe out) {
093      var output = out.getRawOutput();
094      if (output instanceof HjsonWriter output2)
095         return output2;
096      var w = new HjsonWriter(out.getWriter(), isUseWhitespace(), getMaxIndent(), isTrimStrings(),
097         ctx.useNewlineSeparators, ctx.useQuotelessStrings, ctx.useQuotelessKeys, ctx.omitRootBraces,
098         ctx.useMultilineStrings, isUseWhitespace(), getUriResolver());
099      out.setWriter(w);
100      return w;
101   }
102
103   @Override
104   protected void doWrite(SerializerPipe out, Object o) throws IOException, SerializeException {
105      if (o == null)
106         return;
107      var aType = getClassMetaForObject(o);
108      var eType = getExpectedRootType(o);
109      var hw = getHjsonWriter(out).i(getInitialDepth());
110      // Apply object swap before type check (e.g., surrogate serializers convert D1 → D2).
111      ClassMeta<?> sType = aType;
112      var swap = aType.getSwap(this);
113      if (nn(swap)) {
114         o = swap(swap, o);
115         sType = swap.getSwapClassMeta(this);
116         if (sType.isObject())
117            sType = getClassMetaForObject(o);
118      }
119      if (sType.isBean() || sType.isMap()) {
120         var omitRoot = ctx.omitRootBraces;
121         if (sType.isBean())
122            writeBeanMap(hw, toBeanMap(o), getBeanTypeName(this, eType, sType, null), omitRoot);
123         else
124            writeMap(hw, (Map) o, eType, omitRoot);
125      } else {
126         writeAnything(hw, o, eType, "root", null);
127      }
128   }
129
130   private void writeBeanMap(HjsonWriter out, BeanMap<?> m, String typeName, boolean omitBraces) throws SerializeException {
131      var i = indent;
132      out.objectStart(omitBraces, i);
133      indent++;
134      var first = Flag.create();
135      Predicate<Object> checkNull = x -> isKeepNullProperties() || nn(x);
136
137      if (nn(typeName)) {
138         var pm = m.getMeta().getTypeProperty();
139         writeKey(out, pm.getName(), i, first);
140         writeString(out, typeName);
141         first.set();
142      }
143
144      m.forEachValue(checkNull, (pMeta, key, value, thrown) -> {
145         var cMeta = (ClassMeta<?>) pMeta.getBeanInfo();
146         if (nn(thrown))
147            onBeanGetterException(pMeta, thrown); // HTT: onBeanGetterException always throws when reached (a live SerializerSession never has ignoreInvocationExceptionsOnGetters() silently swallow here), so JaCoCo cannot register full instruction coverage past a call that never returns
148         if (canIgnoreValue(pMeta, key, value))
149            return;
150         writeKey(out, key, i, first);
151         writeAnything(out, value, cMeta, key, pMeta);
152         first.set();
153      });
154
155      indent--;
156      out.objectEnd(omitBraces, indent);
157   }
158
159   private void writeKey(HjsonWriter out, Object key, int depth, Flag first) throws SerializeException {
160      if (first.isSet())
161         out.memberSeparator(depth);
162      else
163         out.cr(depth);
164      var keyStr = toString(key);
165      if (out.needsQuoting(keyStr))
166         out.quotedString(keyStr);
167      else
168         out.quotelessString(keyStr);
169      out.keyValueSeparator();
170   }
171
172   private void writeMap(HjsonWriter out, Map m, ClassMeta<?> type, boolean omitBraces) throws SerializeException {
173      var i = indent;
174      out.objectStart(omitBraces, i);
175      indent++;
176      var keyType = type.getKeyType();
177      var valueType = type.getValueType();
178      var first = Flag.create();
179
180      forEachEntry(m, x -> {
181         var value = x.getValue();
182         var key = generalize(x.getKey(), keyType);
183         writeKey(out, key, i, first);
184         writeAnything(out, value, valueType, key == null ? null : toString(key), null);
185         first.set();
186      });
187
188      indent--;
189      out.objectEnd(omitBraces, indent);
190   }
191
192   private void writeCollection(HjsonWriter out, Collection c, ClassMeta<?> type) throws SerializeException {
193      var eType = type.getElementType();
194      out.arrayStart();
195      indent++;
196      var first = Flag.create();
197      forEachEntry(c, x -> {
198         if (first.isSet())
199            out.memberSeparator(indent);
200         else
201            out.cr(indent);
202         writeAnything(out, x, eType, "<iterator>", null);
203         first.set();
204      });
205      indent--;
206      out.arrayEnd();
207   }
208
209   private void writeString(HjsonWriter out, String s) throws SerializeException {
210      if (s == null) { // HTT: unreachable -- every call site either explicitly guards non-null first (writeBeanMap's `nn(typeName)` check) or only ever passes a formatter's result (writeDate/writeCalendar/writeTemporal/writePeriod/writeDuration/UriResolver#resolve/toString) computed from an already-non-null value (writeAnything re-checks `o == null` right after the swap, before any of these calls can fire), so `s` is always non-null here; confirmed by runtime probing (never observed null across the full Hjson test suite).
211         out.w("null"); // HTT: unreachable -- see above.
212         return; // HTT: unreachable -- see above.
213      }
214      if (ctx.useMultilineStrings && s.contains("\n"))
215         out.multilineString(s);
216      else if (out.isSimpleValue(s))
217         out.quotelessString(s);
218      else
219         out.quotedString(s);
220   }
221
222   protected HjsonWriter writeAnything(HjsonWriter out, Object o, ClassMeta<?> eType, String attrName, BeanPropertyMeta pMeta) throws SerializeException {
223      if (o == null) {
224         out.w("null");
225         return out;
226      }
227      if (eType == null)
228         eType = object();
229
230      var aType = push2(attrName, o, eType);
231      var isRecursion = aType == null;
232
233      if (aType == null) {
234         o = null;
235         aType = object();
236      }
237
238      if (isOptional(aType)) {
239         o = getOptionalValue(o);
240         eType = getOptionalType(eType);
241         aType = getClassMetaForObject(o, object());
242      }
243
244      var sType = aType;
245      var swap = aType.getSwap(this);
246      if (nn(swap)) {
247         o = swap(swap, o);
248         sType = swap.getSwapClassMeta(this);
249         if (sType.isObject())
250            sType = getClassMetaForObject(o);
251      }
252
253      if (o == null || (sType.isChar() && ((Character) o).charValue() == 0)) {
254         out.w("null");
255      } else if (sType.isBean()) {
256         writeBeanMap(out, toBeanMap(o), getBeanTypeName(this, eType, aType, pMeta), false);
257      } else if (sType.isMap()) {
258         if (sType.isBeanMap())
259            writeBeanMap(out, (BeanMap) o, getBeanTypeName(this, eType, aType, pMeta), false);
260         else
261            writeMap(out, (Map) o, eType, false);
262      } else if (sType.isCollection()) {
263         writeCollection(out, (Collection) o, eType);
264      } else if (sType.isArray()) {
265         writeCollection(out, toList(sType.inner(), o), eType);
266      } else if (sType.isNumber() || sType.isBoolean()) {
267         out.append(o);
268      } else if (sType.isUri() || (nn(pMeta) && pMeta.isUri())) {
269         writeString(out, getUriResolver().resolve(o));
270      } else if (sType.isDate()) {
271         writeString(out, writeDate((Date)o, sType));
272      } else if (sType.isCalendar()) {
273         writeString(out, writeCalendar(o, sType));
274      } else if (sType.isTemporal()) {
275         writeString(out, writeTemporal((TemporalAccessor)o, sType));
276      } else if (sType.isDuration()) {
277         var value = writeDuration((Duration)o);
278         if (getDurationFormat().isNumeric())
279            out.append(value);
280         else
281            writeString(out, value);
282      } else if (sType.isPeriod()) {
283         writeString(out, writePeriod((Period)o));
284      } else if (sType.isStreamable()) {
285         writeStreamable(out, o, sType, eType);
286      } else if (sType.isReader()) {
287         pipe((Reader) o, out, SerializerSession::handleThrown); // HTT: javac's synthetic bridge for this method ref always throws (handleThrown re-throws any IOException as SerializeException), so JaCoCo can't register full coverage past it
288      } else if (sType.isInputStream()) {
289         pipe((InputStream) o, out, SerializerSession::handleThrown); // HTT: same JaCoCo limitation as the isReader() branch above
290      } else {
291         writeString(out, toString(o));
292      }
293
294      if (!isRecursion)
295         pop();
296      return out;
297   }
298
299   private void writeStreamable(HjsonWriter out, Object o, ClassMeta<?> sType, ClassMeta<?> type) throws SerializeException {
300      var eType = type.getElementType();
301      out.arrayStart();
302      indent++;
303      var first = Flag.create();
304      forEachStreamableEntry(o, sType, x -> {
305         if (first.isSet())
306            out.memberSeparator(indent);
307         else
308            out.cr(indent);
309         writeAnything(out, x, eType, "<iterator>", null);
310         first.set();
311      });
312      indent--;
313      out.arrayEnd();
314   }
315}
